title: Coefficient-first vector projection comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N>0 annihilate A, S a Noetherian scheme with N invertible, and F a locally free S-module of rank d. Use the vector-bundle geometry, Tate coefficient W, chosen compactification, ordinary lower functor and coefficient-first projection of [def-pur-vector-integration-adjunction-arrows]. Let K belong to the ordinary constructible finite-Tor subcategory [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. In the coordinates of [def-pur-vector-tensor-site-equations] and [def-pur-finite-site-tensor-projection], let hW certify W bounded below and let e be the compact-support comparison component at W [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction]. Then the twisted pullback pi^*K tensor W is bounded below, and there exist ordinary and pro-etale projection isomorphisms pe and pp. Their inverses equal the actual coefficient-first projection maps (the pro-etale map includes the canonical tensor/pullback comparison). They satisfy tensorComparison.hom followed by tensor(CK).map(e.inv) and pp.inv = C.map(pe.inv) followed by the inverse compact-support comparison at the twisted pullback. No finite-field or flatness hypothesis on A over Z/N is imposed.

Apply the already proved source-library lemma Etale.plus_derivedTensor_leftDerivedUpperStar to bounded W and the Tor interval in hK.2; this bounds W tensor pi^*K below. The canonical signed derived symmetry transports this bound to pi^*K tensor W. The private vector_twisted_plus helper carries out this boundedness calculation.

Expanding pp and cancelling inverse pairs proves the asserted projection square. This calculation includes rank zero and the empty base.

theorem vectorTensorProjectionComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A S)
    (hK : Etale.DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S K)
    (hW : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
      (Etale.vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d F))
    (e : genericVectorSource A N hA S d F ≅
      (comparison A S).obj (Etale.vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F))
    (he : e = (compactSupportSiteComparison A
      (Etale.vectorBundlePurityCompactification S d F)).app
        ⟨_, hW⟩) :
    ∃ (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
          (Etale.vectorBundlePurityTwistedPullback A N hA S d F K))
      (pe : (Etale.vectorBundlePurityLower A S d F).obj
          (Etale.vectorBundlePurityTwistedPullback A N hA S d F K) ≅
        ((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).obj K).obj
          (Etale.vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F))
      (pp : (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (Etale.vectorBundlePurityCompactification S d F)).obj
            ((comparison A _).obj
              (Etale.vectorBundlePurityTwistedPullback A N hA S d F K)) ≅
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).obj ((comparison A S).obj K)).obj
          (genericVectorSource A N hA S d F)),
      pe.inv = Etale.vectorBundlePurityProjectionMap A N hA S d F K ∧
      HEq pp.inv (comparedModuleProjection A
        (Etale.vectorBundlePurityCompactification S d F)
        (Etale.vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d F) K) ∧
      (tensorComparison A S K (Etale.vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F)).hom ≫
          ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).obj ((comparison A S).obj K)).map
            e.inv ≫ pp.inv =
        (comparison A S).map pe.inv ≫
          (compactSupportSiteComparison A
            (Etale.vectorBundlePurityCompactification S d F)).inv.app ⟨_, hM⟩
